title: Rust test summary joins the status block, and the CLI grows a changeset/pr split
summary: This change adds a Rust test summary — tests added, changed and removed between a base ref and HEAD — computed by parsing both sides of each changed .rs file with tree-sitter, never by building or running the code. The summary is rendered into the pull request status block by `osf pr status refresh` and by `osf pr status render --base`, and is printable on its own via the new `osf changeset tests`. Alongside it the CLI is regrouped: `osf risk` becomes `osf changeset risk`, `osf status` becomes `osf pr status`, and a refresh with no existing block now starts one with a placeholder instead of doing nothing. Supporting git plumbing (merge base, name-status diff with renames, path existence) is added to the git module.

nodes.label: osf CLI
nodes.subtitle: clap command tree
nodes.summary: The command tree is regrouped: `changeset` carries `risk` and the new `tests`, `pr` carries `section` and `status`. `pr status render` gains `--base`, and `pr status refresh` now always produces a block.

nodes.label: changeset tests
nodes.subtitle: --base <ref> --head <ref>
nodes.summary: Prints the Rust test summary on its own, calling the same summarize and render the status block uses.

nodes.label: pr status refresh
nodes.subtitle: recompute the block from live state
nodes.summary: Now also builds the test summary between the base and HEAD and threads it into the block, and starts a block with a placeholder when the description has none.

nodes.label: pr status render
nodes.subtitle: --base optional
nodes.summary: Given `--base`, computes the test summary against HEAD and carries it in the rendered block; without it the block is byte-identical to before.

nodes.label: changeset_tests
nodes.subtitle: summarize / render
nodes.summary: Parses the base and head versions of each changed .rs file with tree-sitter, keys tests by module path plus function name, and classifies each as added, changed or removed. Files it cannot parse are reported as unparsed; non-Rust test files as not yet supported.

nodes.label: tree-sitter-rust
nodes.subtitle: grammar, no build or run
nodes.summary: The Rust grammar the summary parses with. A file with a syntax error is reported unparsed rather than guessed at.

nodes.label: changeset_risk
nodes.subtitle: renamed from risk
nodes.summary: The blast radius assessment, renamed. Its TEST_FILES pattern is now shared with the test summary and widened to match prefix-style test file names at any depth.

nodes.label: pr_status
nodes.subtitle: renamed from status
nodes.summary: The status block renderer, renamed. RenderInput gains an optional pre-rendered tests section, placed between Approach and the end marker; the module stays a pure function of its inputs.

nodes.label: git plumbing
nodes.subtitle: merge_base, diff_name_status_between, path_exists_at
nodes.summary: New helpers: the merge base of two refs, a name-status diff that reports a rename once with both paths, and a path-existence check that distinguishes a missing path from a failed read.

nodes.label: Local git repository
nodes.subtitle: refs, blobs, diffs
nodes.summary: Every read is against a ref: the merge base, the changed file list, and the base and head content of each file.

nodes.label: gh CLI
nodes.subtitle: pr view / pr edit / pr checks
nodes.summary: Reads the pull request description, checks and review state, and writes the new description back.

nodes.label: status-block workflow
